trickyParts: The answer had to stay a 200: three probes read /healthz (ECS container health check, GKE readiness, the image's own HEALTHCHECK), and a refusal would replace the only listener into the same failing rebuild whose cold caches warm up empty, so its fanout would acknowledge general-topic messages as unmatched. The PR body's census names each probe with its disposition.

The paging signal's pattern is matched against the wire format of Go's default text handler, not against a quoted phrase: level=ERROR and the plural 'hooks' are what keep the WARN below the grace out of the alarm.
The stall must not start at a listener's first connection: the lock test advances a whole grace before any reconnect, and was shown to fail under the one-line mutation that would break it.
deviations: The approved plan chose 503. The architect's decision on review round 1 replaced it with 200 degraded plus the AWS alarm (dispatch://INFRA-743/comment/7d723c9e-5924-491f-9f4b-3e64d9512963); the plan document is not edited, as the spec and plan stay as approved.

The reviewer's optional HookStallErr() refactor is declined, with the reason on its thread: with the answer now 200 degraded, moving the comparison into internal/bus would put the listener's health policy there while /healthz still decides the status word.
